simple.meaning: סְתַר (çᵉthar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to conceal ; figuratively, to demolish.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 5:12. Its contexts include family, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סְתַר (H5642).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סְתַר (çᵉthar) / H5642 is traced through Ezra 5:12, Daniel 2:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.
